summary:
A Russian missile strike on a bus in Kramatorsk, in eastern Ukraine, has killed at least 30 people, officials said, while another count puts the toll at 33 after Russia struck two passenger buses. The attack also wounded 18 people and set a second bus on fire. Ukraine accused Russia of targeting the crowded bus to kill as many civilians as possible, and the regional governor said the Kremlin was 'deliberately targeting civilians.'

Saudi authorities said three people were killed on Wednesday in attacks on two international airports, Abha and King Khalid in Riyadh. The Houthis, Iran-backed rebels in Yemen, claimed responsibility and said they had struck the Riyadh airport. The UN says fighting in Yemen has displaced more than 184,000 people. Residents of the Saudi capital reported hearing booms on Thursday, and India condemned the attacks, which caused civilian deaths and injuries.

Hurricane Isaias has strengthened into the first Atlantic hurricane of 2026 and is spinning toward the southeastern United States. Chevron, Shell and Harbour Energy have begun curbing production and evacuating personnel from offshore facilities in the Gulf of Mexico as the region braces for the storm.

headlines.title: Russian strike on Kramatorsk buses kills at least 30 people
headlines.summary: A Russian missile strike on a bus in Kramatorsk, eastern Ukraine, killed at least 30 people, officials said, with another count putting the toll at 33. The strike wounded 18 people, and the regional governor said the Kremlin was 'deliberately targeting civilians.'

headlines.title: Houthi strikes on Saudi airports kill three people
headlines.summary: Saudi authorities said three people were killed in Houthi attacks on Abha International Airport and King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh. The Houthis claimed responsibility, and India condemned the attacks, which caused civilian deaths and injuries.

headlines.title: Britain keeps East Jerusalem consulate open as a reduced mission
headlines.summary: Britain will keep its East Jerusalem consulate open as a mission after Israel ordered it closed over Britain's halt of trade from Israeli settlements. Israel says most UK diplomats will leave, while Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband says vital services will remain.

headlines.title: Hurricane Isaias becomes first Atlantic hurricane of 2026
headlines.summary: Tropical Storm Isaias has strengthened into the first Atlantic hurricane of 2026 and is heading toward the southeastern United States. Chevron, Shell and Harbour Energy have begun curbing Gulf of Mexico production and evacuating offshore personnel.

headlines.title: South Korea to recall ambassador from Ukraine over POW dispute
headlines.summary: South Korea said it will recall its ambassador to Ukraine over the transfer of North Korean prisoners of war to Seoul. Seoul is upset that the transfer was made public at the UN and had demanded an apology, which it has not received.

headlines.title: French school protests continue despite government's pledge to act
headlines.summary: Students blockaded high schools and marched through French cities on Thursday, rejecting a promise by Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu to present an education plan by the end of the month. Dozens of people, including students, teachers and police officers, have been injured in the protests.

headlines.title: Anne Carson wins 2026 Nobel Prize in Literature
headlines.summary: Canadian poet and essayist Anne Carson has won the 2026 Nobel Prize in Literature, the Swedish Academy said. The 76-year-old was honoured for her 'bold and inventive oeuvre' that has created new forms for contemporary literature.
